write_up: It’s common for a design resume to list projects without explaining the decisions behind them. Yours points to product design through Loop Fitness and Brightpath Studio, but a recruiter would have to guess what changed because of much of that work. They may finish the resume and move on.

The line about creating Loop Fitness’s first design system in Figma is a good model: it names what you made and the tool you used. Your current barista role accounts for the time since Loop Fitness, but the resume doesn’t show whether you’ve done any design work since then.

Let’s start with the Loop Fitness booking flow. Add the problem you were designing for and what changed, if you can confirm it. Then give the releases and member tests the same treatment, and include recent design work or portfolio projects if you have them.
